title: Keypad
desc: Generator for keypads with mechanical switches.

items.name: FingerJoint_style
items.label: style
items.desc: style of the fingers

items.name: FingerJoint_surroundingspaces
items.label: surroundingspaces
items.desc: space at the start and end in multiple of normal spaces

items.name: FingerJoint_bottom_lip
items.label: bottom_lip
items.desc: height of the bottom lips sticking out  (multiples of thickness) FingerHoleEdge only!

items.name: FingerJoint_edge_width
items.label: edge_width
items.desc: space below holes of FingerHoleEdge (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_extra_length
items.label: extra_length
items.desc: extra material to grind away burn marks (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_finger
items.label: finger
items.desc: width of the fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_play
items.label: play
items.desc: extra space to allow finger move in and out (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_space
items.label: space
items.desc: space between fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_width
items.label: width
items.desc: width of finger holes (multiples of thickness)

items.name: h
items.label: h
items.desc: height of the box

items.name: top1_thickness
items.label: top1_thickness
items.desc: thickness of the button hold layer, cherry like switches need 1.5mm or smaller to snap in

items.name: top2_enable
items.label: top2_enable
items.desc: enables another top layer that can hold CPG151101S11 hotswap sockets

items.name: top2_thickness
items.label: top2_thickness
items.desc: thickness of the hotplug layer, CPG151101S11 hotswap sockets need 1.2mm to 1.5mm

items.name: pcb_mount_enable
items.label: pcb_mount_enable
items.desc: adds holes for pcb mount switches

items.name: led_enable
items.label: led_enable
items.desc: adds pin holes under switches for leds

items.name: diode_enable
items.label: diode_enable
items.desc: adds pin holes under switches for diodes

items.name: cutout_type
items.label: cutout_type
items.desc: Shape of the plate cutout: 'castle' allows for modding, and 'simple' is a tighter and simpler square

items.name: columns_definition
items.label: columns_definition
items.desc: Each column is separated by '/', and is in the form 'nb_rows @ offset x repeat_count'. Nb_rows is the number of rows for this column. The offset is in mm and optional. Repeat_count is optional and repeats this column multiple times. Spaces are not important.For example '3x2 / 4@11' means we want 3 columns, the two first with 3 rows without offset, and the last with 4 rows starting at 11mm high.

items.name: thickness
items.label: thickness
items.desc: thickness of the material (in mm)

items.name: burn
items.label: burn
items.desc: burn correction (in mm)(bigger values for tighter fit)

items.name: format
items.label: format
items.desc: format of resulting file

items.name: labels
items.label: labels
items.desc: label the parts (where available)

items.name: reference
items.label: reference
items.desc: print reference rectangle with given length (in mm)(zero to disable)

items.name: tabs
items.label: tabs
items.desc: width of tabs holding the parts in place (in mm)(not supported everywhere)

items.name: qr_code
items.label: qr_code
items.desc: Add a QR Code with link or command line to the generated output

items.name: inner_corners
items.label: inner_corners
items.desc: style for inner corners

items.name: spacing
items.label: spacing
items.desc: spacing around parts (multiples of thickness [: extra space in mm])

items.name: debug
items.label: debug
items.desc: print surrounding boxes for some structures
